title: Happy 7 Months
pages:
Happy 7-month anniversary.

Thank you for being by my side for these seven months: the fun days, the tiring days, and even the days we were upset with each other. Every time I get to talk to you makes me happy.

I'm not very good with words,
so I tried to make something with my own hands, little by little.

I wanted you to have something next to you on the days I can't be there.

I have something for you.
Go on, open it.
after: From now on I'll be on your screen with you every day
Poke me, pick me up, or let me remind you of your plans
